items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: Then later Norman Granz came through with this new Jazz at the Philharmonic and he asked me if I'd play with them.

ctx.x: Then later Norman Granz came through with this new Jazz at the Philharmonic and he asked me if I'd play with them. I was very popular then, you know, drawing big crowds so I told him yes, if you will get permission for me to play with the New York Symphony, and I'll play for you for nothing. So he did. Mr. Ripp was the manager then. (movements) What I did was to arrange three of the Zodiac Suite. I had Brent Milton Aranda who was way out, way ahead of Coltrane or anybody. I don't know if you ever heard of him.
